title: TX queue: renormalize FIFO sequence before uint64 wrap
description: Round-2 review found raw uint64_t enqueue ordering still fails at the theoretical UINT64_MAX to zero wrap, making newly enqueued entries appear oldest. Renormalize the at-most-four live entry orders before terminal wrap while preserving relative FIFO order, and add an actual UINT64_MAX regression test.
acceptance_criteria: Enqueue at next_enqueue_order UINT64_MAX renormalizes live orders and preserves FIFO/oldest-lowest preemption; no counter wrap can reverse ordering; sanitizer-backed tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by host sanitizer suite plus review cycle; superseding round-4 findings are tracked separately
